content.text:
It isn't dead code. `--legacy-imports` adds a `pkg/_legacy.py` to the bundle. That file re-exports `group_totals` and `parse_amount` under their pre-1.0 names, `sum_by` and `to_decimal`. Anyone still importing the old names keeps working only if the bundle is built with the flag. The docstring in `scripts/build.py` says this.

The flag only affects `dist/`, not the source tree. `pkg/` has no `_legacy.py`, and `git log -S` shows the word "legacy" appearing only in the 1.3.2 release commit. So the runbook step is the only thing that keeps the shim in released bundles.

I can't tell from the repo whether anyone still uses the old names. The tests don't cover them, and nothing says when the shim was meant to go. If you want to drop it, you'd remove the flag from step 4. You'd probably also want to remove the option from `build.py` and note the removal in the changelog, since it would break any pre-1.0-style imports. I haven't changed anything. Do you want me to?
